profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary:
Javascript/Typescript Developer with an interest in scalable, readable, and intuitive code. Minor experience with Functional style patterns. Mainly using Typescript, React, Mongo, GraphQL, Express

     I began my dive into computer programming in March of 2018. Since then, I've spent every moment I've had studying every aspect of Computer Science I could. I began with C not even knowing how much extra work I was making for myself. After a few months I  discovered python and immediately fell in love! I dove right into intensive, highly-customizable, web applications using python-flask and flask-alchemy to create rich databases with Object-Relational-Mappings and responsive Views to present that data. I eventually realized that without extensive knowledge in Javascript, the responsiveness part would be quite difficult. Thus began my real journey! 
    I am now a HUGE Javascript fan-boy. I spend everyday now testing my JS skills in various TDD-style CLI tools (ie. exercism, nodeschool), putting said skills into practice with React.js (my new favorite JS library), and putting together various projects. Even though I feel as though I know Javascript like the back of my hand, I know my continued learning will always keep me humble and I will always be learning, failing, and creating.
   I am currently looking to find a place where I can continue to grow my skills, continue to learn the things I am interested in, and especially to continue to learn things I don't even know I don't know yet! I pride myself on my patience, resilience, and most importantly, my curiosity! If I just continue to feed my curiosity with new knowledge and I continue to pick myself up every time I break my code, then there will be no challenge too large to overcome.
